connector.name: Umbraco CMS MCP Dev
connector.registryDescription: A developer focused model context protocol (MCP) server for Umbraco CMS
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-dev. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the umbraco account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: UMBRACO_BASE_URL

env.name: UMBRACO_INCLUDE_TOOL_COLLECTIONS
env.description: Comma-separated list of tool collections to include (e.g., document,media,document-type)

env.name: UMBRACO_READONLY
env.description: Enable readonly mode to disable all write operations (create, update, delete). Only read and query tools remain available.
